title: Add staging-to-main sync step to the release docs process
body:
The staging branch of airflow-site accumulates docs from earlier release candidates, so a new release's staging docs are built on top of stale content. Resetting staging to main first gives each vote a clean staging site. It must not happen while another release is being voted on, because that vote's staging docs would be wiped, so the command warns and asks for confirmation before triggering the workflow.
